newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Railcorp carloads up 41 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Railcorp carloads up 41 pct.

text.p: Pioneer Railcorp said Monday the number of carloadings it shipped during 1996 increased by a record 41 percent over the previous year.
Pioneer said carloadings shipped last year totaled 32,015 compared with 22,769 carloadings in 1995. Carloadings are one of the factors in determining Pioneer's gross revenues.
Pioneer also said it has begun operating Michigan Southern Railroad based in White Pigeon, Mich.
The company said it has the exclusive right to purchase Michigan Southern at an undisclosed, predetermined price during the two-year lease period agreed to with its privately-held owner.

The addition of Michigan Southern provides Pioneer with another 5,000 carloading shipments generating revenues of about $1 million annually, it said. The purchase would make the line Pioneer's 13th short line railroad subsidiary.
The Michigan short line interchanges with Conrail Inc and the Indiana Northeastern Railroad Co for destinations served by the Norfolk Southern Corp.
Michigan Southern is only 35 miles from Pioneer's West Michigan Railroad Co, providing the company with a higher level of economies of scale, it said.
